name: Avenue des Petits Travaux · Odd-jobs Avenue

st_bricoleurs.name: Allée des Bricoleurs · Do-It-Yourselfers' Alley
st_bricoleurs.alt: A high-summer country path between tree-lined lawns and a wooden fence: a mime hides in a rose bush, one lays bricks for a birdhouse, one ties two milk pitchers together, a gold-beret mime with a mirror joins the fence, one shells peanuts over a tea cake at a picnic table, one wears a ladybird costume with a may-blossom crown. A wooden gateway leads back to the street; a pink hedge door, a yellow cottage door with a bell, a red barn and a green hedge arch lead on.

doors.label: Ruelle des Houppettes · Powder-Puffs Lane
doors.hint: Through the pink door in the rose hedge

doors.label: Rue du Réveille-Matin · Alarm-Clock Street
doors.hint: Through the yellow cottage door with the bell

houppettes.name: Ruelle des Houppettes · Powder-Puffs Lane
houppettes.alt: A summer lane of pink pom-pom hydrangeas curving to a grassy hill: a mime drives two children in a little cream car, one cheers on the hilltop in sunglasses, one powders a curly wig, one quick-draws a paintbrush beside a startled pony, one blows bubble gum while erasing a drawing, one hauls a huge book out of his backpack. The pink garden gate on the left leads back.

doors.label: Allée des Bricoleurs · Do-It-Yourselfers' Alley
doors.hint: Back through the pink garden gate

reveillematin.name: Rue du Réveille-Matin · Alarm-Clock Street
reveillematin.alt: A cottage back garden at sunrise with a lily pond and a checked breakfast table: a mime pedals a red pedal boat, one gasps at a tipped breakfast tray, a gold-beret mime with a mirror waves away jam doughnuts, a mime with a mirror showers under a watering can, one pops green peas into a bowl, one leaps at a ringing alarm clock. The yellow cottage door with the bell leads back.

doors.label: Allée des Bricoleurs · Do-It-Yourselfers' Alley
doors.hint: Back through the yellow cottage door

selliers.name: Rue des Selliers · Saddlers' Street
selliers.alt: A sunny stable yard behind the red barn: a mime saddles a brown pony, one scrubs a wash tub whose foam towers like a cloud, one pours a sachet of sawdust on a puddle, one re-ties a snapped swing rope, one brushes a white horse's mane into frizzy curls, one sits on a hay-bale throne with a blue jay. The open barn doors lead back.

doors.label: Allée des Bricoleurs · Do-It-Yourselfers' Alley
doors.hint: Back through the open barn doors

rendormis.name: Impasse des Rendormis · Back-to-Sleep Close
rendormis.alt: A shady summer close under a great oak with a sleepy blue-doored cottage: a mime carries a basket crammed with buns, a gold-beret mime sleeps in a hammock, a mime dozes against the oak, a green-beret mime stretches beside a young deer, a mime hangs a posy on the picket gate. The green hedge arch on the left leads back.

doors.label: Allée des Bricoleurs · Do-It-Yourselfers' Alley
doors.hint: Back through the green hedge arch
